findings.title: Valid client agent/task pair bypasses the new gate through isAuthor
findings.blocks: Full machine-other-author and spoof-resistance acceptance; narrow owner/admin exception repair is effective
findings.evidence_kind: Source-path proof; exploit not executed (no DB/service mutation permitted)
findings.trigger: Legacy-mode valid mcn_ principal whose owner is a current workspace member sends X-Agent-ID=victim agent and X-Task-ID=any existing task belonging to that agent; target ordinary comment is authored by that agent. Member JWT/PAT can use the same fallback in both modes.
findings.effect: resolveActor returns victim agent without checking caller-to-agent/runtime authority, task liveness or credential binding; isAuthor=true permits PUT/body/attachment replacement and DELETE although isAdmin=false.
findings.missing_regression: A valid unrelated same-workspace agent/task pair. Existing spoof uses a new random nonexistent task ID, and Cloud test only forges X-Actor-Source against human comments.
findings.recommendation: Parent must define and constrain legitimate legacy agent-author authority (or apply a comment-local verified-author rule); add HTTP tests for known valid foreign pairs, terminal pairs, cloud and ordinary-member JWT/PAT, preserving actual mat_ self and human admin controls. Shared resolveActor changes need explicit scope/design review.
